sloka: उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महौजसाम् ।सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महाबलः ।। ७.९१.२६ ।।
transliteration: upakāryā mahārhāśca pārthivānāṁ mahaujasām ।sānugānāṁ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahābalaḥ ।। 7.91.26 ।।

translations.english: The mighty Rama, the best among men, commanded that splendid temporary dwellings be arranged for the powerful kings and their retinues. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 91 ।। Thus ends the ninety-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
